test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The age of the older of two boys is thrice that of the younger. 9 years ago it was five times that of the younger. Find the present age of each.
solution:
**Given:**

The age of the older boy is thrice that of the younger.

9 years ago, the age of the older boy was five times that of the younger.

**Formula Used:**

Let the present age of the younger boy be y years.

The present age of the older boy = 3y years.

9 years ago:

The age of the younger boy = y - 9 years.

The age of the older boy = 3y - 9 years.</p&g
